snippet.title: FARTPUZZLER - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
A new Fartpoop Simulator game Exists!!!! FARTPUZZLER is a Somewhat brand new take on the falling block Game where rotating your Play field using the trigger buttons is the only way to escape eminent Danger. Let's Get ready for the Fartastic Voyage, Playable at SAGExpo2026 & itch.io. Yes

Download and play on itch.io: Coming Soon
Download and play at SAGExpo2026: https://www.sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/fartpuzzler.3084/

Game design, programming, music, artwork: @kbmodo 
Artwork, character design: @SouperSaucer 
Additional music: @centurionceeiscool 

GenAI Statement - GenAI was used with extreme curation to exclusively assist programming. Everything you play, see, and hear was created/designed by a human.
